responsibility: Implements invocation of the external C preprocessor for GNU Modula-2 source files. It builds the command line from `M2Options` state, including dependency-generation flags such as `-MD`, `-MMD`, and `-MQ`, chooses output filenames for preprocessing-only mode, saved temporaries, or anonymous temp files, runs the command via `system`, reports failures, and tracks generated temporary files in a list that is removed at process exit unless `-save-temps` style options request they be preserved.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the executable implementation of preprocessing: it builds and runs the external C preprocessor command, chooses `.m2i` output/temp paths, and removes temporary files at exit, whereas the same-name `.def` file only declares `PreprocessModule`.
